properties.name: firemud.communication.max-message-length
properties.description: Maximum number of characters accepted for a single communication message before the service rejects it.

properties.name: firemud.communication.defaults.say-enabled
properties.description: Whether the built-in SAY communication mode is enabled in the shared communication pipeline.

properties.name: firemud.communication.defaults.whisper-enabled
properties.description: Whether the built-in WHISPER communication mode is enabled in the shared communication pipeline.

properties.name: firemud.communication.defaults.tell-enabled
properties.description: Whether the built-in TELL communication mode is enabled in the shared communication pipeline.

properties.name: firemud.communication.defaults.whisper-observer-metadata-enabled
properties.description: Whether flagged whisper observers receive metadata-only bystander views by default.
